home.heroTitle: A place to pray, learn, and serve together
home.heroSubtitle: Ann Lite is a Christian platform that helps you grow in your spiritual life — through prayer, God's Word, and serving those in need.
home.disclaimer: Ann Lite is a tool to accompany you in your faith — it does not replace your church, your community, or your personal relationship with God.

donate.title: Make a donation
donate.intro: Every donation helps us support vulnerable children, orphans, and elders in need. We cannot promise any spiritual blessing in exchange — serving is a response to God's love, not a transaction.
donate.byCelo: Donate on the Celo network (CELO / cUSD)
donate.transparencyNote: All crypto donations are publicly verifiable on the Celo blockchain.

impact.title: Impact
impact.intro: Clear numbers on how donations are used, drawn from verified financial reports.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.intro: We believe transparency is a duty, not an option. Verify every crypto donation directly on the blockchain.
